info.title: Pericope ERM API
info.description: Authenticated API over the Pericope Oracle schema. Sign in with POST /api/auth/login; the session is an httpOnly cookie. State-changing requests must send `X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest`.

riskBands.description: A likelihood × impact score at or above a threshold falls in that band.

truncated.description: True when the table exceeded the listing cap.

Row.description: A database row; keys are lower-case column names.
